title: Riftn Documentation — Nduzi, Token, dApps & FAQ
description: Official Riftn akwụkwọ: n 'elu ikpo okwu nnyocha, dApps, token aku na uba, staking, egwuregwu, roadmap, FAQ na ndị ọzọ.
body:
Ihe niile ị chọrọ iji jiri ikpo okwu anyị rụọ ọrụ, jikọọ, wuo, ma gbasaa. Site na ntuziaka mmalite ngwa ngwa ruo nhazi dị elu.

Ọsịịsọ & Ntụkwasị Obi

Ewuru na cheenị kachasị nchekwa na ọsọ kachasị gafee L1s na EVM L2s.

Echedoro

Ndị njide tokeni na-agba nọọdụ n'ụwa niile iji mee ka netwọk rụọ ọrụ ma nweta ụgwọ ọrụ

Nkwado Onye Mmepụta

Anyị na-akwado ọrụ obodo na atụmatụ ebe anyị nwere ike

Obodo

Obodo guzosiri ike na nkwado site na 2021.
